notes: Learning Community of Douglas and Sarpy Counties (cash basis, governmental funds only; entity type other). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4). Roll-forward ties: 27,068,674 + 15,377,964 - 14,791,374 = 27,655,264. Beginning cash = beginning fund balances (p4). Balance sheet from the Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis (p1); no liabilities. Statement of Activities (p2) shows spending by object per function (personnel 2,006,488, contracted/purchased services 11,373,449, supplies 344,275, occupancy 808,822, other 258,340; total 14,791,374). Its object lines replace the function-only budget-schedule lines in detail (Administration and Coordinating Council columns = General Fund; Elementary Learning Centers column less Occupancy = Elementary Learning Centers Fund; Occupancy = Capital Projects lease payments, kept from p7), so nothing is double counted. Capital Projects budget line 'Capital Outlays' has no actual ('--') and is omitted. Budget schedules cover all three major funds, no double counting. Elementary learning centers functional category is a judgment (instruction). Read pages 1-7 of 7
